verdict.rationale: SigNoz exposes a programmatic API, which service accounts are documented to access, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, the pack contains no evidence of an interactive or try-it API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The MCP server, Agent Skills and llms.txt are adjacent AI-access features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
